topic: Fundamentals of Vectors: The Language of Space
target_audience: High school students or introductory undergraduate students

sections.title: Introduction: Scalars vs. Vectors
lecture_lines: Vectors describe both magnitude and direction.
Imagine a cat weighing five kilograms.
Its jumping velocity is a vector.
Vectors are arrows in our space.
animations: Label s as 'Scalar' and v as 'Vector'.

sections.title: Vector Representation and Components
lecture_lines: A vector splits into horizontal, vertical parts.
animations: Draw Cartesian plane with grid lines (#333333).

sections.title: Vector Addition: The Parallelogram Rule
lecture_lines: Parallelogram rule shows the resultant path.
Boat speed plus river current vectors.

lecture_lines: Modern software relies on vector math.
